schema_notes: Targets all rows in category 'Meaning, Faith & Existential Questions' and its known aliases.
Does not overwrite existing reviewed_by attribution.
The DB script queries by category rather than slug list since the full category corpus is not enumerable from batch files alone.
sql_proposal:
update public.questions_master
set
  reviewed_by = 'rick-julian',
  reviewed_at = '2026-06-22'::date,
  review_status = case when lower(coalesce(review_status, '')) in ('reviewed', 'approved', 'published') then review_status else 'reviewed' end
where category in ('Meaning, Faith & Existential Questions', 'Spiritual Struggle / Existential Crisis', 'Spiritual Doubt', 'Existential', 'Life Purpose')
and (reviewed_by is null or reviewed_by = 'rick-julian');
